items.title: Replace personal data with made-up data and purge it from the public history and every clone

handoff.outcome: GitHub's branches and every reachable clone on six accounts hold only the made-up data; a scan of every stored file version and checkout file finds no line that held personal data. Limits: GitHub still serves the old commits by hash and keeps four pull-request refs until Support acts; the closet laptop's clones remain until it is powered on; Antti's private vault history keeps copies of one skill's old files.
handoff.obligation: When the closet laptop is next powered on, run the removal commands given in the task thread; forward GitHub Support's reply to the thread; decide whether the private vault's history should lose the copied skill files.
handoff.prerequisite: The removal needs the closet laptop powered on; the Support step needs GitHub's reply; the vault decision has no prerequisite.

checks.command: A=email-mailbox-analyzer/scripts/email-mailbox-analyzer.sh; d=$(mktemp -d); bash -n "$A" && bash "$A" --help >/dev/null && { (cd "$d" && HOME="$d" THUNDERBIRD_PROFILE= bash "$OLDPWD/$A" >/dev/null 2>&1); test $? -eq 1; } && python3 jmap/sync_emails.py --help >/dev/null && { env -u JMAP_ACCOUNT_ID python3 jmap/sync_emails.py >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 2; } && uv run --script fonecta-lookup/scripts/fonecta_lookup.py --help >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc

S=/home/agent/.local/state/skills-akaihola-history-rewrite/2026-11-02; t=$(mktemp); git rev-list --objects ff5dd4de0f1be62a2a4d813a19d3430d850863f1 | cut -d' ' -f1 > "$t" && a=$(grep -cxFf "$S/poisoned-objects.txt" "$t" || true) && b=$(awk 'NR>1 && $1!=$2 {print $1}' "$S/commit-map.txt" | grep -cxFf "$t" || true) && echo "objects that held personal data: $a; replaced commits: $b"; rm -f "$t"; test "$a" = 0 && test "$b" = 0

git grep -I -h -o -E '\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b' ff5dd4de0f1be62a2a4d813a19d3430d850863f1 -- . ':!docs/tasks/34-*' | sort -u | python3 -c "import sys; m=[l.split() for l in open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()[1:] if len(l.split())==2]; old={a for a,b in m if a!=b}; new={b for a,b in m}; t=[x.strip() for x in sys.stdin]; bad=[x for x in t if any(o.startswith(x) for o in old) and not any(n.startswith(x) for n in new)]; print('old commit references:', len(bad)); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)" /home/agent/.local/state/skills-akaihola-history-rewrite/2026-11-02/commit-map.txt

S=/home/agent/.local/state/skills-akaihola-history-rewrite/2026-11-02; d=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q https://github.com/akaihola/skills-akaihola.git "$d/c" && a=$(git -C "$d/c" cat-file --batch-check < "$S/poisoned-objects.txt" | grep -vc ' missing$' || true) && b=$(awk 'NR>1 && $1!=$2 {print $1}' "$S/commit-map.txt" | git -C "$d/c" cat-file --batch-check | grep -vc ' missing$' || true) && c=$(git -C "$d/c" log --all --format='%ae%n%ce' | sort -u | grep -cvE '@users\.noreply\.github\.com$|^noreply@github\.com$|^noreply@example\.com$|@openclaw\.local$' || true) && echo "objects that held personal data: $a; replaced commits: $b; other addresses: $c" && test "$a" = 0 && test "$b" = 0 && test "$c" = 0; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc
